title: Dashboard render input
description: Render a composed, decision-centric DASHBOARD (the fixed metric-overview template: KPI row + trend + breakdown + optional geo) from a declarative DashboardSpec IR. Carries shared datasets, heterogeneous panels (any of the 11 of the 13 viz.render chartTypes (chord and flow_map are viz.render-only, decision #881), or kpi tiles), layout hints, cross-filter links, and a dashboard-level a11y block. The server composes each panel through the in-process viz.render engine, resolves the layout (m02), computes KPIs (m03), and applies any active cross-filter selection (m03/m04). Option C: per-chart specs are unchanged; this IR sits above them.
$comment: FROZEN SEAMS — mission-start audit (s113-m01, Rule 1). These 5 integration seams are frozen NOW so m02/m03/m04 add code, not schema churn. (a) CROSS-PANEL DATA-SHARING: shared dataset-level rows at `datasets[]`; panels reference a dataset by `datasetId` + field refs in `encodings` — NOT inline-rows-per-panel, which bloats payload AND blocks cross-filter (tabular panels must share a dimensional space). Non-tabular branches (hierarchy/sankey/network/geo) are structurally distinct and carried inline on the panel. (b) PARTIAL-PANEL ERROR policy: `onPanelError` default 'placeholder' — render an a11y-described error panel in-place, don't void the whole dashboard. (c) CROSS-SOURCE LINK combination: `crossFilter` default { combine:'and', ignoreSelfSource:true } — each active source ANDs a predicate; a panel ignores its OWN source selection; per-link override via `links[].combine`. (d) DASHBOARD-LEVEL A11Y: `a11y` (required) carries a cross-panel summary + `readingOrder` default 'kpi-first' (KPI row read/focused before charts); the per-chart AccessibilitySpec stays per-panel. (e) TOKEN strategy: one dashboard-level `tokenCssRef` (deferred to the consumer CSS bundle per viz.render's compact/tokenCssRef posture); KPI threshold metadata is SEMANTIC only (`threshold.direction`/`value`) — colors do NOT resolve inline. ALSO frozen in m01 (as hand-authored TS, not this schema, since they are runtime interaction state not declarative config): the Selection / SelectionState types in packages/viz-core/src/spec/dashboard-selection.ts, so m03 (cross-filter resolver) and m04 (linked-selection reducer) depend ONLY on m01. The links predicate vocabulary reuses the SectionFilter operator grammar (==|!=|in|not_in|>|>=|<|<=). DEFERRED: brush/interval RANGE selections (point/categorical only v1); anomaly narration (threshold/outlier flag only); the general composer (fixed template first). DOWNSTREAM CONTRACT CLARIFICATIONS (frozen so m02-m05 add code, not schema): (i) KPI TIME AXIS — the KPI sparkline, comparison.basis 'window', and aggregate 'latest' ALL read DATASET ROW ORDER as the time axis (rows arrive pre-ordered from the producer); there is no separate KPI period/time field in v1 (an explicit period axis would be a v0.2 additive field — the most likely future churn point). (ii) CROSS-FILTER SOURCE DIMENSION — DashboardLink.sourceField defaults to the source panel's primary dimension = a TABULAR panel's encodings.x field; a non-tabular source panel (hierarchy/sankey/network/geo) has no encodings block and MUST set links[].sourceField explicitly, else it is not a valid v1 cross-filter source. (iii) SELECTION VALUES — cross-filter Selection.values are string|number ONLY in v1 (boolean dimensions out of scope), so the m04 canonical-ordering normalizer never sorts a boolean. (iv) VENDORED COPY — packages/viz-core/src/spec/dashboard-spec.schema.json is a hand-synced byte-identical copy of this source (the validator inlines it); a viz-core parity test asserts identity, but re-copy on every edit and keep it in the s113 closeout gate sweep.

theme.description: CSS token theme for chart pixels. HC token scopes are exported but browser system-color pixels are not supported.

schemaVersion.description: IR version discriminant (V01 convention). A future template/shape change bumps to v0.2.

id.description: Stable identifier for the dashboard instance.

title.description: Human-friendly dashboard title surfaced in UI + narration.

datasets.description: SEAM (a) cross-panel DATA-SHARING. Shared, named tabular datasets. Tabular chart panels and KPI panels reference one by `datasetId`; sharing a dataset is what makes cross-filter possible (panels filter the same dimensional space).

panels.description: Heterogeneous panels: chart (11 of the 13 viz.render chartTypes; chord and flow_map are viz.render-only, decision #881 — plus its data branch) or kpi tiles.

links.description: Cross-filter wiring: a selection on a source panel filters a target panel. Declared in v1 (schema-frozen) so m04 adds only a reducer, not a schema change.

onPanelError.description: SEAM (b) partial-panel ERROR policy. 'placeholder' = render an a11y-described error panel in-place (default — don't void the dashboard); 'omit' = drop the failed panel from the layout.

resolveMeasures.description: Phase-3 governed-measure RESOLUTION switch (sprint-117). When true, a KPI panel carrying a `measureRef` has it resolved against the governed-measure registry BEFORE compute: the registry's entityField/aggregate OVERRIDE the author's field/aggregate, and any default comparison/threshold fills only where the author omitted them. An unknown measureRef under this flag becomes an a11y-described error panel (OODS-V130) routed through `onPanelError`, NOT a silent value. DEFAULT false keeps measureRef fully inert and the output byte-identical to s116. A render-call control (like `selection`/`output`), so it lives only on the tool input — NOT in the DashboardSpec IR; it never reaches computeKpi (resolution is strictly input-side and is never echoed onto output panels).

strictFields.description: Field-presence STRICT switch (sprint-118 m05). When true, a referenced field absent from EVERY resolved (non-empty) row is surfaced as OODS-V131 at the ingestion boundary instead of a silent value:0 / confident-wrong spec: a KPI panel's field (+ periodField) and a tabular chart panel's encoding fields (x/y/color/size/shape/detail) must each be a key in >=1 row, else the panel is routed through `onPanelError` (placeholder = a11y-described error panel; omit = warning + drop). DEFAULT false keeps the legacy silent-empty behavior byte-identical. Scoped to field-presence ONLY — the frozen-D6 missing-datasetId silent-empty path (empty rows) is unchanged. A render-call control (like resolveMeasures); never reaches computeKpi.

strictDatasets.description: Unknown-datasetId STRICT switch (sprint-122 m03). When true, a KPI panel whose datasetId is NOT present in datasets[] fails through onPanelError (OODS-V139). A KNOWN dataset that filters/cross-filters to zero rows STILL renders value:0 (unchanged). Does NOT affect chart panels (their missing-datasetId path keeps OODS-V123). Default false = the legacy frozen-D6 silent-empty behavior, byte-identical.

a11yEquivalence.description: A11y equivalence CERTIFY-AT-EMISSION switch (sprint-134 m03; gate sprint-135 m04). DEFAULT ON. Each cartesian chart panel's emission is checked against the accessible-equivalence engine: an error-severity failure makes an error panel (first per-rule OODS-A11Y-<rule.id> code), warn-severity failures fold into the dashboard `warnings` as OODS-A11Y-<rule.id> prefixed with the originating panel id. Default builder output is conformant-BY-CONSTRUCTION (sprint-135 m02); set false to opt out for agent-supplied non-conformant panels. Scoped to cartesian chart panels (ECharts-primary/geo panels are excluded).

tokenCssRef.description: SEAM (e) TOKEN strategy. One dashboard-level deferred token CSS reference (e.g. 'tokens.build'); tokens stay deferred to the consumer CSS bundle (viz.render compact posture). When supplied, this exact reference is returned in compact output. KPI threshold colors are NOT resolved inline.

brand.description: CSS token brand for the dashboard document and chart pixels; defaults to A. The contrast scan grades the same scoped document tokens.

selection.description: Optional accumulated cross-filter SelectionState, keyed by sourceWidgetId (one active selection per source). When present, each panel's rows are cross-filtered (skip-self + AND-across-sources) before render/KPI compute; absent -> the unfiltered dashboard.

compact.description: When true, omit full token CSS and return a tokenCssRef instead.

echarts.description: When true, also include the ECharts option for tabular panels (ECharts-primary panels always include it).

includeNormalizedSpec.description: When true, also return each successfully rendered chart panel's intermediate NormalizedVizSpec IR on panels[].normalizedSpec. This is one call-level opt-in mirroring viz.render; KPI and error panels are unchanged, and the emitted IR sits outside the dashboard contentHash projection.

html.description: Opt-in render-to-SVG export (sprint-115). When true, additionally emit a self-contained HTML document on the output `html` field: Vega-Lite panels (trend/breakdown) rendered to inline SVG via @oods/viz-render, KPI tiles, and normalized inline SVG for all six admitted ECharts-primary panel types. Absent/false leaves the output byte-identical to the compact/echarts payload.

dataTable.description: A11y completeness (sprint-118 m07). When true AND output.html is set, append a screen-reader-only data-table inside each tabular chart <figure> whose cells equal the charted rows (the chart's encoding columns). DEFAULT false keeps the HTML byte-identical.

contrastScan.description: A11y completeness (sprint-118 m07). When true, run the four-pair token contrast preflight over the export's ALREADY-RESOLVED brand-token colour pairs (no filesystem read) and push OODS-V135 warnings for any pair below its WCAG threshold. This is a token preflight, not whole-dashboard WCAG certification. DEFAULT false emits nothing.

dataQualityField.description: A11y completeness (sprint-118 m07). When set (e.g. 'flag') AND output.dataTable is on, tally that column's data-quality codes (FAOSTAT E=estimated / I=imputed / X=external / blank=official) into a <caption> footnote per data-table. Pure presentation over a parameter — no Forge-side fetch.

includeA11y.description: When true, attach a STRUCTURED two-part text alternative (accessible data table + narrative summary) to each chart panel result (panels[].a11y), derived from the SAME data source the panel renders from (Forge-Demos FD#10) — for cartesian and non-cartesian panels alike. DEFAULT false keeps the wire byte-identical (panels carry only a11yDescription).

Dataset.description: A named shared dataset. Panels reference it by id; cross-filter operates over its shared dimensional space.

rows.description: Flat tabular rows (field name -> value), bounded like viz.render.

Panel.description: A dashboard panel: a chart panel (11 of the 13 viz.render chartTypes; chord and flow_map are viz.render-only, decision #881 — plus its data branch) or a kpi tile. Discriminated on `kind`.

ChartPanel.description: A chart panel — a viz.render-shaped descriptor: chartType (11 of the 13 viz.render chartTypes; chord and flow_map are viz.render-only, decision #881) + the matching data branch + encodings. Tabular types (bar/line/area/scatter/heatmap) bind a shared dataset via `datasetId` + `encodings`; treemap/sunburst take `hierarchy`; sankey takes `sankey`; force_graph takes `network`; choropleth/bubble_map take `geo`.

id.description: Unique stable identifier for this chart panel within the dashboard; duplicate panel ids are rejected with OODS-C003.

description.description: Optional per-panel accessibility description override (flat string, mirrors the viz.render input).

chartType.description: 11 of the 13 viz.render chartTypes; chord and flow_map are viz.render-only (decision #881).

datasetId.description: References a top-level dataset by id. Required for the tabular types (bar/line/area/scatter/heatmap).

measureRef.description: OPTIONAL governed-measure reference (sprint-130 m03). When `resolveMeasures` is set, the resolved registry entry's governed context (displayName/unit/format/threshold/comparison) DECORATES this chart panel's a11y narrative as a leading measure finding. NARRATIVE-ONLY: unlike KpiPanel.measureRef it does NOT rewrite the chart's compute inputs (resolveMeasurePanel is KPI-typed); the chart's encodings/data branch are untouched. An UNKNOWN measureRef under resolveMeasures is a hard error (OODS-V130), mirroring the KPI path (governance consistency). Absent or flag-off === byte-identical.

KpiPanel.description: A KPI tile — the only NEW panel primitive (trend/breakdown/geo already ship as chart types). Reserves value/aggregate/comparison/threshold metadata; the actual compute is deferred to m03 (which reduces the cross-filtered dataset rows to a renderer-agnostic payload).

id.description: Unique stable identifier for this KPI panel within the dashboard; duplicate panel ids are rejected with OODS-C003.

datasetId.description: References a top-level dataset by id.

field.description: The metric field aggregated into the KPI value. CELL TYPES (sprint-175, FD#1): `count` and `distinct` are defined over every NON-NULL cell of this field regardless of type — COUNT(field), never rows.length — while the numeric aggregates (sum/average/median/min/max/latest) read only cells that parse as numbers, in BOTH the row-order and `periodField` series builders. A field that HAS values but none numeric fails LOUD for a numeric aggregate (OODS-V160 at dashboard.render, routed through onPanelError) instead of returning a plausible 0; a field absent from every row has zero non-null cells and keeps the ratified value:0.

periodField.description: Optional (v0.2, sprint-114) name of the time column. When present, the KPI metric series is built along a parsed and sorted period axis (via analysis/temporal.ts) instead of dataset row order: aggregate 'latest' is the max period, the sparkline is period-ordered, and comparison.basis 'window'/'prior_period' slice by DISTINCT periods (not rows). Rows with an unparseable period cell are dropped; duplicate periods keep all rows in stable order. Absent keeps the sparkline, aggregate 'latest', and the 'window'/'prior_period' bases on dataset row order (as in v0.1); the KPI trendDirection is reported 'flat' unless a comparison baseline resolves, because a first-vs-last read of arbitrary row order is not a real trend (sprint-149 F6b).

measureRef.description: Reserved (sprint-116, Phase-3 beachhead): an optional bare governed-measure reference, a provenance/identity key (e.g. 'gm.revenue'). Inert in v1: unread by computeKpi and never echoed to output. field and aggregate stay the authoritative compute inputs, so an absent or present measureRef yields byte-identical compute (no golden re-bake) and schemaVersion stays 'v0.1'. Validation is string-only this sprint: not an inline {name,field,aggregate,role} object, and no registry/enum lookup. Reserved for the governed-measure resolver (measureRef to field and aggregate at the mcp-server boundary) in a subsequent gated sprint.

aggregate.description: Point-in-time aggregate. Adds 'latest' (most recent value by row order, or by the explicit periodField when set) to the viz.render aggregate set, for point-in-time KPIs. CELL TYPES (sprint-175, FD#1): `count`/`distinct` accept any non-null cell; the other six read numeric cells only and raise OODS-V160 when the field has values but none of them numeric (pre-s175 they returned a silent 0).

KpiComparison.description: Comparison basis for the KPI delta. stats.ts deriveTrend is first-vs-last only; this reserves prior-period / target / window bases (computation deferred to m03).

field.description: RESERVED (v0.2): a future sibling-baseline column name. NOT the prior_period key; under an explicit KpiPanel.periodField, prior_period/window are derived from the DISTINCT periods of the metric series itself. Unread in v1.

value.description: For basis 'target': the explicit target to compare against.

window.description: For basis 'window': the trailing window size.

KpiThreshold.description: Threshold / anomaly metadata. SEMANTIC only (direction/value) — colors do NOT resolve inline (SEAM e: tokens deferred to the consumer CSS bundle). m03 computes the breach/anomaly flag (reusing stats.ts stddev/tukey for the outlier detector).

direction.description: Whether a breach is the value above or below the threshold.

anomaly.description: Optional anomaly detector to flag (Phase-4 narration deferred — flag only).

Encodings.description: Channel -> field bindings for tabular chart panels (mirrors the viz.render encodings shape).

EncodingBinding.description: An encoding binding: a bare field-name string, or an object with the field plus optional aggregate/scale/timeUnit/sort/title.

type.description: Force the Vega-Lite/ECharts field type, overriding the engine's data-aware inference (sprint-125 m02 manual escape hatch). Wins over the m01 profile-derived type.

HierarchyData.description: Hierarchy data for treemap/sunburst panels — discriminated union on 'type' (mirrors the viz.render hierarchy branch).

HierarchyNode.description: A nested-hierarchy node: a name, an optional numeric value, and optional recursive children.

SankeyData.description: Flow data for a sankey panel — nodes plus value-weighted links (mirrors the viz.render sankey branch).

NetworkData.description: Network data for a force_graph panel — nodes plus directed links (mirrors the viz.render network branch). An empty links array is allowed.

GeoData.description: Geo data for choropleth/bubble_map panels — inline geometry + per-type encoding (mirrors the viz.render geo branch). Geometry is supplied INLINE, never fetched.

topojson.description: Inline TopoJSON Topology (converted to a FeatureCollection).

valueField.description: Choropleth: the numeric field colouring each region. Required for choropleth.

longitudeField.description: Bubble map: the longitude field. Required for bubble_map.

latitudeField.description: Bubble map: the latitude field. Required for bubble_map.

DashboardLayout.description: Optional layout hints consumed by the m02 deterministic auto-layout resolver. Absent hints -> declared panel order + KPI-row-first defaults; the resolver emits abstract {x,y,w,h} (renderer-agnostic, the client sizes the canvas).

placements.description: Per-panel grid hints (gridSpan / order). A panel without a placement uses resolver defaults.

gridSpan.description: How many grid columns the panel spans.

DashboardLink.description: A cross-filter link: a selection on the source panel filters the target panel. The predicate vocabulary reuses the SectionFilter operator grammar. m04 adds the reducer; this schema does not change.

source.description: Source panel id (its selection drives the filter).

target.description: Target panel id (filtered by the source selection).

sourceField.description: Dimension the source selection is on (defaults to the source panel's primary dimension).

targetField.description: Field on the target to filter (defaults to sourceField).

operator.description: Predicate operator (SectionFilter grammar). Defaults to 'in' for categorical/point selections.

combine.description: Per-link override of crossFilter.combine (v1 supports 'and' only).

CrossFilterConfig.description: SEAM (c) cross-source LINK combination. Default: each active source ANDs a predicate; a panel ignores its OWN source selection (skip-self). Per-link override via DashboardLink.combine.

combine.description: How predicates from multiple active sources combine (v1: 'and' only).

ignoreSelfSource.description: When true, a panel ignores selections that originated from itself.

DashboardA11ySpec.description: SEAM (d) dashboard-level accessibility: a cross-panel summary + reading/focus order. The per-chart AccessibilitySpec stays per-panel; this is the dashboard envelope.

description.description: Cross-panel screen-reader summary of the whole dashboard.

ariaLabel.description: Short ARIA label applied to the dashboard container.

readingOrder.description: Panel reading/focus order. 'kpi-first' surfaces the KPI row before charts (the metric-overview default); 'declared' uses panel declaration order.

SelectionPredicate.description: A pre-derived predicate (SectionFilter grammar) carried by a selection.

Selection.description: One panel's active cross-filter selection (point/categorical only in v1).

sourceWidgetId.description: The panel id that produced the selection.

dimension.description: The field/dimension the selection is on.
